title: Shanghai: The Vertical Surge of Pudong
summary: Witness Shanghai rise building by building, from historic Bund granite to the vertical surge of Pudong's supertall cluster above the Huangpu.

fields.director_notes: Prompt: Adapt city-grows-3d to choreograph Shanghai's transformation across the Huangpu River from 1843 to 2026. MiniMax M3.1 Flash role: Directed historical era chronology, camera trajectories circling the Lujiazui bend, architectural heights, and narration timing. Visuals: 1,456 authentic OpenStreetMap 3D building footprints rising by historical construction year. Audio: MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD English narration paired with synthesized orchestral score bed.
fields.my_city_line: From mudflats to clouds: Pudong's vertical surge.
